677:t_103:6.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Stay out of it, $$シルヴィア$$. This is how $$アポロ$$ and $$ミカゲ$$ settle things.」

677:t_103:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... You truly are the heir to the Mechanical Angel... and a man I once believed in...」

677:t_103:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Here I come, $$ミカゲ$$! I'll punch you out and end this!」

677:t_103:9.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'll do it for $$頭翅#pilot$$, who's waiting for you, too!」

677:t_104:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I'm sure $$セリアン$$, your past incarnation, had a kind heart too...」

677:t_104:4.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! You came here to...」

677:t_104:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Say nothing. Besides, I have no intention of dying in vain.」

677:t_104:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Come, $$ミコノ$$! Kindness alone will not see you through the battles ahead!」

677:t_104:7.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「...Here I come, $$ミカゲ$$. I'll bring your days of fighting to an end!」

677:t_105:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! You spread hatred in the name of love, and I'll stop you!」

677:t_105:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... Perhaps my love truly was warped...」

677:t_105:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You, the girl with grass-green hair, and the girl with pink and gold hair... Your triangle will live on in another form: trust and friendship...」

677:t_105:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Surely that is the proper form for a defeated love to grow into...」

677:t_105:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But I too have the pride of a $$堕天翅$$. I will not lose to a mere Wingless.」

677:t_105:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Come, boy who carries his feelings on his wings! Use that power to surpass me!」

677:t_105:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's fight, $$ミカゲ$$! My wings cut through the wind faster than any $$天翅$$'s!」

677:t_106:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「You stole my freedom and used me as a tool! There's plenty I'd like to say to you...!」

677:t_106:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「But none of that matters anymore! I'll take you down here to protect $$ランカ$$ and the world!」

677:t_107:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Why won't you try to understand each other?! You knew how to communicate with the $$バジュラ$$, yet you used it to control them!」

677:t_107:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「People like you spread war through the universe! I'll stop you here, for the $$バジュラ$$ too!」
